cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.60% · WTI +1.44% · Brent -2.69% · NatGas +13.27%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.96%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.96%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -7.91%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +12.35%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +12.35%, LEU +11.15%, FLNC +9.27%, UUUU +8.86%, UEC +8.06%. Laggards: VLO -9.24%, DINO -8.81%, MPC -7.36%, PSX -7.03%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: HUBB moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: HUBB is -5.47% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
